title: A real signup reaches Google Ads as one GA4 sign_up key event, joined to the ad-click session

source.ref: Daniel launched the Google Ads campaign 'Find your people locally' (2026-11-09) optimized for subscriptions.

detail:
account.created was mirrored to GA4 as account_created on EVERY sign-in (the ledger deduped, the mirror did not) and with the profile id as client_id, so no event joined an ad-click session. Fix: the auth callback hands track() the browser's _ga client_id and session_id; track() sends GA4 sign_up (method) once, only when the ledger row is new and only when the visitor carries a _ga cookie. Owner steps: link GA4 to Google Ads, mark sign_up a key event, import it into Ads as the conversion. Gate in docs/RUNBOOKS.md (Google Ads conversion).

sign_up sent once per signup via track(); owner steps in RUNBOOKS
